## Intent and anchors
- Goal: implement approved proposals 1–4 as exact closed calculation, shared with eval.
- Tracer: floor(-7/3)=-3; artifacts in examples/proof_nodes/equal/by_builtin_rule/closed_*_calculation.lit.

- Non-goals: modular exponentiation (5), finite set extensions (6), AST/Env/Runtime state changes, unrelated concurrent verifier repairs.
- Baseline: rational leaf lacks rounding/integer/sqrt/log and re/img branches; eval complex leaf handles only C_abs; current tree has independent concurrent edits.

1. Build current release, retain an exact executable, reproduce isolated baseline positives/negatives and record JSON evidence.

3. Wire existing closed calculator/eval, add only local radical evidence representation, preserve verifier-state/search ownership.
4. Add dedicated tracers, focused Rust tests and paired negatives; update affected Manual/FAQ/source README and Obj records.
- Impact: L3 local producer/consumer evidence addition for radicals; selected exact numeric family, closed calculation/output and eval tests plus direct artifacts/docs snippets. Skip full kernel, textbooks, Lean (no IR/compiler change; unsupported routes remain fail-closed).
- Stop/escalate: unsettled public semantics, protected state/AST change, or required nonlocal search change.

- [ ] New proof/WD artifacts have zero trust; documentation describes bounded exact support.

# Closed exact elementary calculation

Status: active

## Intent and anchors
- Goal: implement approved proposals 1–4 as exact closed calculation, shared with eval.
- Tracer: floor(-7/3)=-3; artifacts in examples/proof_nodes/equal/by_builtin_rule/closed_*_calculation.lit.
- Owners: rational_expression/{exact_rational,exact_complex,decimal_arithmetic}; central calculate_closed_atomic_fact; eval numeric leaves.
- Invariants: no float approximations, no synthesized premises, source WD checked first, checked arithmetic/bounded normalization returns unsupported on exhaustion.
- Non-goals: modular exponentiation (5), finite set extensions (6), AST/Env/Runtime state changes, unrelated concurrent verifier repairs.
- Baseline: rational leaf lacks rounding/integer/sqrt/log and re/img branches; eval complex leaf handles only C_abs; current tree has independent concurrent edits.

## Action protocol
1. Build current release, retain an exact executable, reproduce isolated baseline positives/negatives and record JSON evidence.
2. Extend pure numeric owners: exact rational rounding/integer operations and perfect sqrt/log; bounded radical normal forms; re/img coordinate projections.
3. Wire existing closed calculator/eval, add only local radical evidence representation, preserve verifier-state/search ownership.
4. Add dedicated tracers, focused Rust tests and paired negatives; update affected Manual/FAQ/source README and Obj records.
- Impact: L3 local producer/consumer evidence addition for radicals; selected exact numeric family, closed calculation/output and eval tests plus direct artifacts/docs snippets. Skip full kernel, textbooks, Lean (no IR/compiler change; unsupported routes remain fail-closed).
- Stop/escalate: unsettled public semantics, protected state/AST change, or required nonlocal search change.

## Completion evidence
- [ ] Stable release build and exact baseline/final receipts.
- [ ] First tracer, four feature artifacts, nearest negatives and eval results pass through public exec_stmt.
- [ ] Focused numeric/output/central calculation contracts pass; source WD/unsupported/overflow boundaries remain rejected.
- [ ] New proof/WD artifacts have zero trust; documentation describes bounded exact support.
- [ ] Durable JSON journal and acceptance note; task-owned draft cleanup and completed ledger removal.

## Contract deviations
- CLI drift: current -f/-e emits structured success; -session is available, obsolete -runner/-compact/-before/try are unavailable. Use actual supported protocol with exit/envelope agreement.
